params.text: Places that channel between the left and right outputs

inputs.text: A bipolar CV, -5 to +5V, over that channel's position, attenuverted by its knob
That channel's signal in; the channels patched to the first one set the polyphony

outputs.text: The left sides of both channels summed, soft clipped at 12V
The right sides of both channels summed, soft clipped at 12V
